system.description:
Self; ritual. Ask one question about a specific course of action to be taken within the next 7 days. You receive a short phrase or omen (weal, woe, both or nothing). The answer is correct 70% plus 1% per level (max 95%); otherwise you receive 'nothing'. Casting again on the same subject gives no new answer. Material: incense and a sacrifice worth 25 gp, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Cleric, Paladin, Witch
